posts.en:
dsh-searxng is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-42adfa890bcece1945f5.html
